description: This file defines the 'SwabbleConfig' struct, which contains nested configuration options for audio, wake, hook, logging, transcripts, and speech components. It also includes 'ConfigError' and 'ConfigLoader' enums for handling configuration loading and saving, with functions to read and write config data from the filesystem.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the configuration from a specified file URL, decoding JSON data into a SwabbleConfig instance.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes the SwabbleConfig instance into JSON and writes it to a specified file URL, creating necessary directories.
